WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
), ratios AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    avg_rental_rate / avg_replacement_cost AS ratio_of_averages,
    film_count
  FROM rating_stats
)
SELECT
  rating,
  ratio_of_averages,
  film_count,
  ratio_of_averages - AVG(ratio_of_averages) OVER () AS difference_from_plain_rating_average
FROM ratios
ORDER BY rating;
